items.t: In South Granville, Vancouver, houses sold at a median of $3,640,000 across 39 sales, and the middle half closed between $2,947,500 and $4,455,000. The median house sat 19 days and sold for 92.8% of list.
South Granville, Vancouver: 13 townhomes sold at a median of $1,450,000, with the middle half between $1,230,000 and $1,525,000. The median townhome took 28 days to sell and closed at 94.8% of list.

12 condos sold in South Granville, Vancouver at a median of $1,064,500 (middle half $1,025,000 to $1,196,250). A typical condo in South Granville, Vancouver spent 46 days on the market and closed at 96.4% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How South Granville compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Houses in South Granville have the second highest median of 17 Vancouver West sub-areas, $3,640,000. University is lowest at $1,549,000 and Shaughnessy highest at $4,817,500. Quilchena ($3,550,000) sits just below and Shaughnessy ($4,817,500) sits just above.

Of 18 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, South Granville ranks 10th highest at $1,450,000; the range is $850,000 (False Creek) to $2,255,000 (Coal Harbour). Kitsilano ($1,405,000) sits just below and Yaletown ($1,454,500) sits just above.

Condos in South Granville have the third highest median of 21 Vancouver West sub-areas, $1,064,500. Marpole is lowest at $613,500 and Coal Harbour highest at $1,228,000. Cambie ($996,900) sits just below and Kerrisdale ($1,150,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in South Granville, Vancouver (median 2019) and houses the oldest (median 1995), a gap of 24 years.
No single South Granville, Vancouver condo building or townhome complex had 3 or more resales over the past year, so none is named here.
